kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتواءم (form VI)
# أَتَوَاءَمُ (ʔatawāʔamu) /ʔa.ta.waː.ʔa.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَوَاءَمَ (tawāʔama)
# أَتَوَاءَمَ (ʔatawāʔama) /ʔa.ta.waː.ʔa.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَوَاءَمَ (tawāʔama)
# أَتَوَاءَمْ (ʔatawāʔam) /ʔa.ta.waː.ʔam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَوَاءَمَ (tawāʔama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
